blocking.field: howto_step_2_des vs faq[5] (Can singers fill in a karaoke sign up sheet on their phones?)
blocking.rule: CONTENT_DEFECTS #10; SEVERITY cross-field mismatch (form-field sets, Divit 2026-11-05)
blocking.finding: Step 2 prescribes four fields: 'Ask for a name or stage name, the song, the artist, and any note the host needs. Stop there.' FAQ 6 says 'Keep it under four questions.' The page's own recommended form breaks its own limit.
blocking.fix: FAQ 6: 'Keep it to four questions at most: name, song, artist and a note for the host.' (or drop the host note from step 2 and keep 'under four').

notes.finding: Cover (dm: true) draws 'To: Horatio Lamplugh, Your sheet is full' with a chat-bubble icon; copy, mockup, tab 4 hero (mail icon) and the cover alt all say email. The 'To:' label keeps it readable as email, but the icon is a message icon.
notes.fix: Render the cover with the mail icon (dm false).

notes.finding: Five feature bodies open on a subjectless verb: 'Shows the singer one question at a time', 'Gives each singer one song per rotation', 'Shows the next five singers', 'Checks each song', 'Adds a line for a duet partner', 'Keeps every night's sign-ups'.
notes.fix: Open each with a subject ('The sheet shows ...') or a concrete scene.

notes.finding: Feature 4 states as a given that 'no ballad gets sung twice in one night', while step 4 presents blocking repeats as a choice ('Choose whether two people may sing the same song'). Not a numeric conflict, but feature 4 could say it is a setting.
notes.fix: Feature 4: 'If you block repeats, the form asks for a second choice ...'.
